Springfield

Mr.
Henry. G. Sherwood

20 Apr. 1785–24 Nov. 1867. Surveyor. Born at Kingsbury, Washington Co., New York. Son of Newcomb Sherwood and a woman whose maiden name was Tolman (first name unidentified). Married Polly by 17 May 1823. Lived at Bolton, Warren Co., New York, 1830. Baptized...

View Full Bio
you will please to pay
John. A. Hicks

?–Dec. 1897. Likely born in Co. Fermanagh, Ireland. Son of Robert Hicks and Frances Armstrong. Likely immigrated to Canada with his family, ca. 1820. Married first Margaret Wilson, 20 Mar. 1834, in Upper Canada. Baptized into Church of Jesus Christ of Latter...

View Full Bio
fifty Dollars and charge the same— to me Yours &c

Elias Higbee handwriting ends; JS begins.

Joseph Smith Jr
The Above order is for mony to bear our expences on the road he will take a lot or land if you have any to please him if not you can sell the lot that Br—
Jonathan Hampton

View Full Bio

was to have I have seen him hes paid me the damage
1

On 10 September 1839, church member Jonathan Hampton agreed to purchase Nauvoo block 157, lot 4, on the northwest corner of Partridge and Lumber streets, from JS, Sidney Rigdon, and Hyrum Smith for $250. JS may have been referring to this lot or perhaps to a different lot Hampton had earlier been interested in purchasing, as Hampton made full payment on this property by 28 March 1840. (JS, Sidney Rigdon, and Hyrum Smith to John Hampton, Bond, Nauvoo, IL, 10 Sept. 1839, Newel K. Whitney, Papers, BYU.)

&c &c
Joseph Smith Jr [p. [1]]
